constraints.subject: users.views.*
constraints.justification: View handlers must not access data models directly

constraints.subject: users.views.*
constraints.justification: All data access must go through service functions; the service layer (users.services) is the sole gateway to the data layer

constraints.subject: users.services.*
constraints.justification: Only the service layer may import from the data model module

note: Do NOT emit prohibits_dependency users.services.* -> users.models.*: services are the sanctioned path to models.

constraints.subject: project.*
constraints.justification: No module outside the service layer may import from the data model module; in this codebase the non-service top-level code lives in the project package (settings/urls/wiring)

note: The ADR states a codebase-wide rule, but a bare '*' subject is not expressible (constraint patterns are exact FQNs or 'prefix.*'). The users-side cases are covered by ADR-001 (views prohibited, services the sanctioned exception). Emit the edge for the remaining root namespace, project.*, not users.*.
